answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the sonnet proves it. The price of trying is £7 in fees and a 26-day delay before the stamp dries, paid up front for every single name, while the sonnet stays small. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One violet, one entry. Every inlet is counted once.
